museumIntro: Move with Left/Right or A/D and press Space to fire one shot. Clear three rows of aliens before they reach your ship. The formation reverses and descends at the edges; aliens fire back. You have three shields, with brief protection after a hit. Play again restarts the game.

museumStory.title: 1978: Space Invaders reaches the arcades
museumStory.text:
Taito released Space Invaders in 1978, created by Tomohiro Nishikado. Its rows of marching aliens became a familiar sight far beyond amusement arcades: table-shaped cabinets appeared in Japanese coffee shops, and venues filled with the game became known as “Invader Houses”.

Our Python version keeps the descending formation and the ship below it. You can explore how movement, firing and a few collision rules create that kind of game.
